board.name: Wyoming Board of Medicine (with a physician assistant advisory council)

licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA)
licence.renewalDeadline: Annual; all PA licences expire December 31 each year (first renewal: licences issued Jan 1 to Aug 31 renew that December 31; issued Sept 1 to Dec 31 renew December 31 of the following year). Late renewal with surcharge allowed through March 31.

ce.categoryRules: At least 60 CME hours (or continued NCCPA maintenance of certification including 60 credits) during the preceding three calendar years, verified at each annual renewal. No category split stated in Ch. 5 Sec. 21. Volunteer clinical service (emeritus) or board consultant service can count.
ce.nccpaNote: Exempt from the CME requirement if certified or recertified by NCCPA within the past three years as of the renewal date; also exempt during the first three years of Wyoming licensure.
ce.nccpaRenewalNote: Initial licence requires passing the NCCPA (or board approved) exam and being currently certified (W.S. 33-26-504(b)(iii)); the renewal rule allows a non NCCPA CME route, and the renewal form asks NCCPA status. No rule loaded makes current NCCPA certification a renewal condition.

topicMandates.topic: Responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs registered with the Wyoming Board of Pharmacy to prescribe controlled substances
topicMandates.source: W.S. 33-26-202(b)(xiv); WY BOM PA renewal application Section V
topicMandates.note: The 2026 renewal form asks whether the hour was completed 'since January 1, 2023', a window longer than the stated two years.

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: At least 1 hour in the preceding two years on responsible controlled substance prescribing or substance abuse disorder treatment, for PAs holding a Wyoming Board of Pharmacy controlled substance registration (attested on the annual renewal application).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: No supervision or collaboration agreement is filed for a PA who has passed the NCCPA (or board approved) exam; board approved supervision agreements for such PAs were deemed terminated January 1, 2022. The degree of collaboration is set at the practice level (employer, group, hospital credentialing). A supervision plan filed with the board is required only for a temporary licensee who has not yet passed the certification exam (supervisor: physician or PA with at least 5 years' licensed experience); changes require a revised plan.
practice.notes: PA may fulfil physician signature requirements except as limited by W.S. 33-26-510(c).

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Wyoming Controlled Substance Registration from the Wyoming Board of Pharmacy is required to prescribe controlled substances and must be obtained before applying for DEA registration; renewed every two years (expires June 30; statute: on or before July 1). PAs may prescribe Schedules II to V, not Schedule I.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 1 hour every 2 years for PAs holding a Board of Pharmacy controlled substance registration (see topicMandates).

rn.renewalDeadline: December 31 of every even year (renewal cycle January 1 odd year to December 31 even year)
rn.ceNote: Continuing competency, one of these in the past two years: 400 hours active nursing practice; pass NCLEX; board accepted refresher course; complete a nursing degree beyond the basic education; or 40 hours of continuing education. CE is only one option. ceHoursPerCycle (40) applies only if the nurse chooses the CE option; it is not a fixed requirement.
rn.notes: Wyoming APRN and RN licences are separate; an APRN who also holds an active Wyoming RN licence only needs to meet the APRN competency requirement.

aprn.title: APRN (Advanced Practice Registered Nurse); licence issued by WSBN
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Separate APRN licence. Wyoming does not require APRNs to also hold a Wyoming RN licence (needed only if the national certifier requires it).
aprn.ceNote: Competency at renewal is current national certification in the role and population focus plus 3 hours CE on responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders. APRNs recognized before January 1, 1999 who are not nationally certified instead submit 40 CE hours and 400 APRN practice hours in the last two years. Advanced pharmacology evidence is an initial licensure item only.

topicMandates.topic: Responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders
topicMandates.appliesTo: APRNs (statute: licensees with prescriptive authority; board rule: each APRN at renewal)

aprn.compactNote: Wyoming has adopted the APRN Compact, but WSBN states it will be implemented only when 7 states have enacted it; no multistate APRN licence is available.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate nursing prescriptive authority registration: prescribing (except Schedule I) is part of the APRN licence definition.
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 3 hours every two years on responsible controlled substance prescribing or substance abuse disorder treatment
prescribing.csNote: Wyoming Board of Pharmacy Controlled Substance Registration required to prescribe controlled substances and before DEA registration; biennial, expires June 30.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: None. Supervision or collaboration agreements are not required by Wyoming law.

unverified: PA: the Board of Medicine rules were read from the board's posted copy (Drive PDF) and the 2025 Notice of Intent ARR25-018P; whether the 2025 amendments were finally adopted, and the official current text at rules.wyo.gov, were not loaded. Ch. 5 Sec. 11, 20 and 21 read the same in both.
PA: no CME category split (AAPA Category 1 minimum) is stated in Ch. 5 Sec. 21.

PA: whether current NCCPA certification is a condition of renewal is not stated; statute ties 'currently certified' to the licence grant (33-26-504(b)(iii)), while the CME rule allows a non NCCPA route and the renewal form only asks NCCPA status.

PA: W.S. 33-26-202(b)(xiv) says 'registered with the board of pharmacy to dispense'; the renewal form applies it to PAs registered 'to prescribe'. Wyoming CS registration covers prescribing, so these coincide in practice.

NP: the WSBN rule requires the 3 controlled substance hours of each APRN, while W.S. 33-21-129(e) applies it to licensees with prescriptive authority; prescribing is part of every Wyoming APRN licence (33-21-120(a)(i)(A)), so these coincide.

No other WY topic mandate (implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse, ethics, HIV, end of life, dementia, suicide prevention, infection control, domestic violence) was found in BOM Ch. 5, WSBN Ch. 2 or Title 33 for PAs or nurses.
